lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-requests-ssrf-no-private-ip-validation
title: SSRF - watch URL fetched or accepted without blocking private/reserved IP addresses
summary: 'A user-supplied watch URL is validated only by syntax and protocol (`is_safe_valid_url`) and
  is then

  fetched with `requests`, which follows redirects automatically. Neither the URL''s resolved IP nor any

  redirect hop is checked against private, loopback, link-local or reserved ranges. An attacker can add
  a

  watch for http://169.254.169.254/ or http://127.0.0.1/, or use an open redirect on a public host, to

  read internal services and cloud metadata.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-918
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b
  vulnerable_ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b^
  patched_ref: fe7aa38c651d73fe5f41ce09855fa8f97193747b
  repository: https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io
rule:
  message: 'A URL is accepted or fetched without verifying that its host (and every redirect hop) resolves
    to a

    public IP address. This allows SSRF to internal services and cloud metadata endpoints. Resolve the

    host and reject private, loopback, link-local and reserved addresses, and follow redirects manually

    with allow_redirects=False, validating each hop.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - patterns:
    - pattern: $S.request(..., verify=False, ...)
    - pattern-not: $S.request(..., allow_redirects=False, ...)
  - pattern: "try:\n    ...\nexcept validators.ValidationError:\n    ...\nreturn True\n"
  - pattern: "if not is_safe_valid_url($U):\n    flash(...)\n    return None\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Add an `is_private_hostname()` helper that resolves the hostname with socket.getaddrinfo
    and returns

    True if any address is private, loopback, link-local or reserved (fail closed when resolution fails).

    Call it in `is_safe_valid_url()` after the format validation, unless the operator has explicitly set

    ALLOW_IANA_RESTRICTED_ADDRESSES to true. Call it again at fetch time to catch DNS rebinding. Send
    the

    request with allow_redirects=False and follow redirects manually, re-checking each hop with a maximum

    hop count.

    '
  example: "def is_private_hostname(hostname):\n    try:\n        for info in socket.getaddrinfo(hostname,\
    \ None):\n            ip = ipaddress.ip_address(info[4][0])\n            if ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback\
    \ or ip.is_link_local or ip.is_reserved:\n                return True\n    except socket.gaierror:\n\
    \        return True\n    return False\n\n# in is_safe_valid_url(), after format validation\nif not\
    \ strtobool(os.getenv('ALLOW_IANA_RESTRICTED_ADDRESSES', 'false')):\n    parsed = urlparse(test_url)\n\
    \    if parsed.hostname and is_private_hostname(parsed.hostname):\n        return False\n\n# in the\
    \ fetcher\nr = session.request(method=request_method, url=url, headers=request_headers,\n        \
    \            timeout=timeout, proxies=proxies, verify=False,\n                    allow_redirects=False)\n"
